verdict.label: Light review
verdict.summary: MetaAds requires registering a custom OAuth app as Composio does not provide a managed app for this toolkit.

composioFit.summary: Composio requires a custom auth configuration for MetaAds since no managed app is available.
whyOwnApp: No Composio-managed OAuth app is available for METAADS.
Custom OAuth app allows control over branding, scopes, and dedicated rate limits.

phases.name: Register MetaAds Account and App
steps: Go to https://metaads.io/register/ and complete the form with your information.
Provide required personal information including full name and contact details during registration.
phases.handoff: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret from the MetaAds developer portal.

phases.name: Configure Composio Auth Config
steps: Open the Composio dashboard and click Create Auth Config.
Choose OAuth2 or API Key auth scheme.
Paste the Client ID and Client Secret into Composio.
phases.handoff: Ready to test authentication using your own account.

artefacts.title: MetaAds Registration Form Notes
artefacts.body: Complete the registration form at https://metaads.io/register/ with your full name and contact details.

requirements.label: Privacy Policy
requirements.when: Required for platform access and service compliance

scopes.purpose: General API and advertising platform access

redirectRules.rule: Use the exact redirect URI provided by the Composio dashboard when creating the custom auth config.

blockers.cause: MetaAds does not expose an OIDC discovery document at the standard well-known path.
blockers.fix: Manually configure authorization and token endpoints in your custom OAuth client.
blockers.fallback: Use API Key auth scheme if available.

blockers.cause: MetaAds does not expose an OAuth authorization server metadata document.
blockers.fix: Obtain endpoint URLs directly from MetaAds documentation or support.
blockers.fallback: Use API Key auth scheme if available.

blockers.cause: Registration is required for everybody who wants to gain access to the platform and use its features.
blockers.fix: Complete the registration process at https://metaads.io/register/.
blockers.fallback: Contact MetaAds support for account activation.

checklist.text: Complete the registration form at https://metaads.io/register/.
Create an Auth Config in the Composio dashboard for METAADS.

uncertainties: OAuth redirect URI strictness and localhost allowance are not explicitly documented.
Exact token lifetimes and refresh token behavior are not documented.
Specific review triggers and verification document requirements beyond registration are not explicitly detailed.
